stem.text: What happens when carbon dioxide is transported by red blood cells?

A.text: Hydrogencarbonate ions move into the red blood cells and chloride ions move into the plasma.

B.text: Chloride ions move into the red blood cells and bind to haemoglobin.

C.text: Chloride ions move into the red blood cells and hydrogen ions move into the plasma.

D.text: Chloride ions move into the red blood cells and hydrogencarbonate ions move into the plasma.
